topic: Myth: Entrepreneurship is too risky for a teenager
caption:
The safest time to try entrepreneurship is when the stakes are basically zero.

Your teen has no bills, no rent, no dependents. A stumble at 16 is a lesson, not a loss.

HustleUp walks them through real side hustles, step by step, so they build confidence alongside the skills.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
